summary: Auto-spin bug FIXED and verified end-to-end. Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 /build?type=ring: 3D ring viewer starts PAUSED on canvas-mode-live (no yaw rotation; only intentional sub-degree 'leaning sway' + sparkle flashes). spin-toggle-button press clearly rotates the ring; press again stops it immediately. Fullscreen 3D also starts paused and fs-spin-toggle-button rotates on press. Admin lead 'Customer notes' row verified: POST /api/quotes with design.notes 'TEST note please call after 5pm' persists; admin UI /admin lead detail renders the 'Customer notes' label and exact text. Test lead cleaned up via POST /api/dashboard/leads/bulk action=delete (count=1, remaining 0).
critical_code_review_comments: ring-viewer.tsx:124 reset() sets vel to 0.35 when autoSpin is true. OK since autoSpin now defaults false; just noting the only path to 0.35 remains deliberate (user explicitly pressed spin, then reset).

Design-canvas: spin state defaults false (line 45) and toggleSpin forwards to both viewer and fullViewer. Fullscreen RingViewer motion ref initializes vel=0 and autoSpin=false, so fullscreen correctly starts paused even if parent spin is true at mount (minor edge: if user toggles spin ON then opens fullscreen, fullscreen will NOT auto-spin until the toggle is pressed again inside FS). Not a bug for this iteration's requirements, but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary quote (id 6adb5b6505a606c3b1d9af94) via POST /api/quotes with TEST_User / test_notes@example.com and design.notes='TEST note please call after 5pm'. Deleted via /api/dashboard/leads/bulk action=delete; verified removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validation methodology for auto-spin: compare canvas screenshots 2s apart. MD5 is too strict due to intentional 'leaning sway' (Math.sin(t*0.7)*0.05 pivot rotation) and always-animating sparkles; use PNG byte-size delta or pixel mean-diff on canvas-only screenshots. Observed: paused delta ~70-300B, spinning delta >5kB. Visual check also useful - spin shows clearly rotated yaw while paused frames remain at same orientation.
rca_of_issue: Previously ring-viewer.tsx initialized motion.ref with vel=0.35 and autoSpin=true, so the 3D view started spinning as soon as mounted. Fix: initial motion vel=0 and autoSpin=false; setAutoSpin(false) also zeros vel immediately (otherwise an in-flight velocity would drift to the target over 1/1.5s rather than halt). design-canvas spin state default is false. Verified: idle 3D canvas no longer rotates; spin only occurs after explicit spin-toggle press; subsequent press stops rotation within ~0.5s.
